plan.title: Award both bids to Vendor B with no approval

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ directly on Master QCS, as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before opening the prepared event.
Open the awarding screen for the closed event.
Allocate the available first line's full quantity to Vendor B.
Verify the available allocation selects one of two bidders and calculates Vendor B's first-line proposal as 10 × ₹90 = ₹900.
Create the proposal from the selected allocation.
Verify that the proposal page opened.
Complete the mandatory proposal fields before submission.
Verify that the award proposal was submitted successfully.
Complete the available awarded flow and create the purchase order for the awarded vendor.
Verify the resulting purchase order contains the available awarded line with quantity 10.
